_what_this_is: Tracked, sanitized evidence for the fee tier that pipeline/fees.py CURRENT_SCHEDULE encodes. The probe's own report lives at logs/stf_cost_report_2026-09-15.json, which .gitignore excludes, so a fresh checkout could not otherwise inspect the evidence behind an operational money constant.
_scope: OPERATIONAL ONLY. This is a current-account measurement adopted for prospective paper/shadow accounting. It is not a research artifact, it is not in any registered code-path list, and it says nothing about what any account paid during the 2020-2026 research periods.
accounting_effective_from_note: A SELECTED accounting-boundary timestamp (00:00 UTC on the day the 4-reading cohort completed), not the instant this schedule went operationally live and not consulted by pipeline/fees.py:active_schedule() at rate-resolution time. It precedes the last supporting reading (2026-09-15T00:05:01Z) by five minutes because it marks the day of confirmation, not a to-the-minute cutover. Actual operational adoption is the date this change merged to main -- see the repository's commit/PR history for that date, not this field.

source_report.why_untracked: logs/ is excluded by .gitignore line 30; the digest and the facts below are what survives a checkout

evidence.credential: view-only key, permissions re-verified against the exchange per reading (can_view true, can_trade false, can_transfer false)
evidence.independently_audited: 14-day execution-cost checkpoint audit, 2026-09-15; cohort integrity clean, statistics reproduced field-for-field

how_to_reverify: a different tier means the account moved: add a NEW schedule with a new id and effective date in pipeline/fees.py, and leave this one in place so trades placed under it keep settling under it
not_permanent: Coinbase tiers move with trailing volume. These are current measured values for one account in September 2026, not Coinbase constants.
